transcript.text:
Thank you all for being here. As you know, the two customer-success teams were merged last month and are now sharing accounts, recurring meetings, and escalation responsibilities. I understand there have been disagreements about who can make decisions when the two former teams have different practices. I have the authority to approve the operating charter for the merged teams, and I'd like to move us toward finalizing that today.

Before we get into the details, I want to follow the standard charter process. I need each team representative and People Operations to state any relevant commitments, constraints, or process requirements that should be reflected in the charter. Once we've heard from everyone and the charter is finalized and approved, it will be published to the merged team as part of the normal sign-off process.

Let's start with the team representatives — please go ahead and share any commitments, constraints, or process requirements you'd like on the record.
